body.x: Xinapse Co., Ltd. (CEO Dong-won Joo) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

As an AI voice technology-based generative AI startup, Xinapse possesses various AI voice conversion technologies, and as such, has flexible scalability. The company explained that, with voice conversion technology, it is leading the commercialization of high-quality AI voice for company services in various fields, such as the metaverse, audiobooks, TV commercials, news, and navigation.

‘HyperReal Voice’, introduced at the trade show, is a software for professionals that can quickly and easily create customized AI virtual voice content. Clients can simply type in text to easily generate AI voices that are natural and similar to human voices, and can adjust the tone, pitch, and speed of the voice with a few clicks and drags. You can replicate the voices of famous people or combine the voices of many people into one to make a company unique voice to make content, and it can even replicate the voice of the deceased.

An official of Xinapse revealed that, “There are a lot of cases of people having ideas but failing to realize them due to not being able to focus on content from the lack of capital. As such, our company researched technology that can generate content with lower costs and in less time, so that more people can focus on ideas and content instead of capital.”

Xinapse’s technology has been applied in various industries, such as animation, TV commercials, audiobooks, the metaverse, and broadcasting media. Child Fund Korea as able to synthesize the voices of 100 children into one to create a TV public service advertisement.

Not resting on their laurels, Xinapse is planning to launch services with various partners in different fields, such as audiobooks, advertisement/marketing, music, and deathcare service, through research on AI voice technology. They have currently completed the PoC for clipbook creation with Disney Korea and is in the middle of discussions with numerous publishers and churches. The company explained that, through this, we will be able to see more audiobooks made with Xinapse’s technology starting from 2023. They also expressed their plans to expand on TMAP and AI voice navigation to build a location-based AI voice advertisement platform, and to collaborate with music platform companies, metaverse companies, and broadcasting companies to create AI music. Together with the company operating Memorial Park, they are also planning to launch a new type of service that combines AI voice content.

The official shared their aspirations, saying, “Xinapse has led Korean AI voice technology and the corresponding market with limited resources. Now, based on a bigger workforce and more resources, we have goals to research more advanced technology and achieve innovation in productivity in various industries. We plan to launch AI voice-based services in the future for consumers around the world, and we have plans to search for opportunities to collaborate with various overseas companies to this end.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
